panel.disclaimer: CAPAG is an indicative screening signal published by the Treasury; the binding rating is computed only when a credit operation is requested. This is prioritization support, not a credit decision.
indicator.debt.name: Debt (Endividamento)
indicator.debt.what: Gross consolidated debt ÷ net current revenue. How leveraged the city already is.
indicator.savings.name: Savings (Poupança Corrente)
indicator.savings.what: Current expenses ÷ current revenues, 3-year weighted average. Whether day-to-day operations leave room to invest.
indicator.liquidity.name: Liquidity (Liquidez Relativa)
indicator.liquidity.what: (Cash − short-term obligations) ÷ net current revenue. Whether the city can pay what's due now.
rec.nd.r1: Treasury does not rate this municipality — its Siconfi fiscal reporting is missing or inconsistent

rec.nd.r3: TA on fiscal data quality unlocks every other instrument
rec.d.r1: Bottom rating: no credit channel is realistic in the near term
rec.d.r2: Pair non-repayable climate funding with fiscal recovery support
